title: What If You Landed on the Far Side of the Moon?

scenes.text: What if you landed on the Moon's far side? Earth would vanish from your sky.
The Moon always shows us one face. The other side never turns toward Earth.
It looks different too, with far fewer dark lava plains and far more craters.
The Moon blocks radio signals from Earth, so engineers need relay satellites to talk to landers there.
That silence makes it a radio-quiet zone, shielded from Earth's noise.
In June 2024, China's Chang'e 6 landed there and brought rocks home. Earth was never in view.

description:
What if you landed on the far side of the Moon?
Earth would never rise in your sky, and Earth's radio signals would be blocked.
What should we run through next?
